system.description:
Whichever side of the law you have worked, you understand police and guard operations, their schedules and their business — and how to disrupt them. Locks, traps, security systems and alarms are all within your purview.

Use Security with Mental Traits to set up a secure area or plan a breach, and to disarm traps, alarms and locks. At a Narrator's discretion, bypassing a physical lock or alarm may require a Physical Trait related to dexterity.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
